desc:
Ecom Swift LLC provides WooCommerce SEO and speed optimization: faster product pages, compressed images, caching and a tidy search setup, so search engines can read your shop and shoppers do not wait.

## What is WooCommerce SEO and speed optimization?

WooCommerce SEO and speed optimization is the work of making your online shop load quickly and making its pages easy for search engines to understand. It covers image size, caching, plugin weight and page structure on the speed side, and titles, descriptions, category pages, sitemaps and product schema on the search side.

## Why speed and search setup go together

Search engines prefer pages that load fast and are clearly organized, and shoppers prefer the same things for their own reasons. A product page that takes too long on a phone often loses the visitor before the first photo appears. A product page with a vague title and a copied description gives search engines little to work with.

WooCommerce adds its own complications. Filters and variations can create many near-identical web addresses. Plugins pile up and add scripts to every page. Product photos arrive straight from a camera at very large sizes. Without attention these issues build up quietly.

## How the work affects traffic and sales

Faster pages reduce the number of people who leave before browsing. Clear titles and descriptions help your listings match what people actually type into a search box, such as a product name and a type. Product schema, which is structured data on the page, helps search engines understand price, availability and ratings, so listings can show richer details where the engine allows it.

Duplicate pages from filters waste a search engine's attention, so cleaning them up points it toward the pages you want found. We cannot control rankings, which depend on competition, content and many factors outside the store. We improve the technical base and the page text you control, and show you the speed results before and after.

## What a thorough pass includes

- Speed tests on key pages before and after the work, on mobile and desktop.
- Image compression and correct sizing across the product catalog.
- Caching configured to suit a shop, with cart and checkout pages handled safely.
- Slow or overlapping plugins replaced or removed.
- Product titles and descriptions improved for clarity and for how people search.
- Category pages given useful text and clear titles.
- Product schema checked and fixed where it is missing or wrong.
- An XML sitemap and robots file reviewed, with Search Console connected.
- Duplicate pages from filters and variations handled with the right settings.
- A content plan listing what to write next.

## How we work

We start by measuring. Speed tests and a crawl of your store tell us what is heavy, what is duplicated and what is missing. We fix the biggest speed problems first, because they affect every page, then move to titles, descriptions and structure.

Checkout and cart pages need special care, since caching them wrongly can break orders. We test a full purchase after each speed change. The Basic package covers speed fixes and search basics on your top pages. Standard extends this across the catalog, with category text, schema checks and Search Console. Premium adds filter and duplicate handling, a checkout speed pass, core web vitals fixes and a longer content plan.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Upload photos at a sensible size before adding them to the store.
- Write product descriptions in your own words, with real detail.
- Keep a short list of plugins you actually use.
- Check the shop on a mid-range phone, not only a fast computer.

**Avoid:**
- Installing several caching or optimization plugins together.
- Copying supplier descriptions that dozens of other stores also use.
- Letting every filter combination create its own indexable page.
- Drawing conclusions from a single speed check of a single URL.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store with a large catalog that feels slow, a seller who has products but gets little search traffic, and a merchant who has added many plugins over time and wants a lighter site. It also suits a shop preparing for a busy season that wants pages ready first.

## What we need from you

Send your store address and a list of your most important products and categories. We need an administrator user, plus access to your Search Console as a user if you have it set up, and we never need your password. Tell us about any plugins you consider essential so we leave them in place.
